lines.zh: 我浮在末地荒地上，翅膀轻轻张开。
lines.en: I hover over the end wasteland, wings half spread.
I step across the void's rim.
My foot falls and makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀折起来，又展开。
lines.en: My wings fold in and spread again.
I head for that floating island.

lines.zh: 白色的骨头在暗里发亮。
lines.en: Pale bone glows in the dark.
I pass through a stand of end stone pillars.

lines.zh: 我低头看脚下，虚空很深。
lines.en: I look down; the void runs deep.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滑行，翅膀几乎不动。
lines.en: I glide slowly, wings almost still.
I skirt the island's edge.

lines.zh: 我身后的空气慢慢合拢。
lines.en: The air closes slowly behind me.
I glide along the argent light.

lines.zh: 我悬停着，翅膀展开不动。
lines.en: I hover with wings held out and still.

lines.zh: 我抬手，掌心浮出血色的光。
lines.en: I raise a hand and blood-colored light floats over it.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一具悬空的骨架。
lines.en: I hold still, a skeleton hanging in air.

lines.zh: 末地的风很轻，拂过我的骨质。
lines.en: The end wind is light over my bones.
I hang in the air and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 血光在我体内慢慢流转。
lines.en: Blood light circles slowly inside me.
I stare at a point in the void.
My wings twitch once.
Endermen make their sounds far off.
I lower my hand and the light goes in.
There is nothing I must hurry for.

lines.zh: 我把手掌翻过来，光在指缝里淌。
lines.en: I turn my palm over and light runs between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把头转向你，骨头咯咯响。
lines.en: I turn my head to you and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 你能站在这片虚空边上，不简单。
lines.en: That you can stand at the void's edge is no small thing.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，血光在眼窝里。
lines.en: I look down, blood light in my sockets.
I reach out, palm toward you.
The blood tone in you runs strong.
I see you as a target.

lines.zh: 你退，我不追，只飘在那儿。
lines.en: You retreat; I do not follow, only drift there.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀遮住了半片天。
lines.en: My wings cover half the sky.
Mortal, lift your eyes to me.

lines.zh: 你不用开口，我知道你要什么。
lines.en: You need not speak; I know what you want.
I draw my palm to my chest.
My bones knock together as if counting time.
If you dare move, I will know.
No living person should be here.

lines.zh: 我被击碎了一块，很快补回来。
lines.en: A piece of me breaks and comes back quickly.
That pushes me back half a foot.
My bones ring for a long while.
The blood light dims and comes back.
My hover tilts off true.
I put a hand out to hold myself.
I look down at the gap.
It hurts, yet I have no blood to spill.
My wings tremble behind me.
I keep that between my bones.
That is of no use to me.
I do not eat that; I only take blood.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我无动于衷。
lines.en: You hold it up and I am unmoved.

lines.zh: 我的手不自觉地抬起来。
lines.en: My hand rises on its own.

lines.zh: 这点东西，连一滴血都不是。
lines.en: That is not even a drop of blood.
I push your hand aside.
You are stalling, and I know it.
I accept this little offering.
I turn my head and go.
Keep it; it may serve you.
You strike me and I drift off a little.

lines.zh: 我的身子轻得很，推不动实。
lines.en: My body is light; there is little to push.

lines.zh: 你从我的骨头上穿过去，撞了个空。
lines.en: You go through my bones and hit nothing.
I raise a palm and take the blow.
I tilt and right myself.

lines.zh: 这么近，你能听见骨头响。
lines.en: This close, you can hear my bones.
I slide over your head.
I draw back a foot to clear the way.

lines.zh: 你撞了个空，脚下没稳住。
lines.en: You hit nothing and lose your footing.
The void is not a thing you can hit.
I am only bone and light.
Such matters have no part in me.
I drift away.
I have no such need.

lines.zh: 我把背对着它，翅膀合上。
lines.en: I turn my back and fold my wings.
My kind have no need to be close.
I raise a hand for it to withdraw.

lines.zh: 血光在我们之间隔了一道。
lines.en: Blood light stands between us.
It leaves, and so do I.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有成对的东西。
lines.en: In the void nothing comes in pairs.

lines.zh: 我把一小块骨头捡起来。
lines.en: I pick up a small piece of bone.
I hold it and turn it over.
It warms faintly in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它收进骨架的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck it into a gap in my frame.

lines.zh: 我捡起弹壳，闻不到一点血。
lines.en: I pick up the shell casing and smell no blood at all.
I drop it back into the void.
This metal reflects my own light.
It is light as nothing.
I crush it and close it in my palm.
I keep it; it may buy something.
You move, and I have locked on.
I raise my hand and point at you.
You are the only thing moving here.
My wings spread fully.
Blood light gathers in my palm.
Your heartbeat gives you away.
I know the blood tone on you.
No more waiting.
I come down out of the void.
Its heart beats, and I hear it.
One lift of my hand and it begins.
Do not look behind you; there is no behind.

lines.zh: 我跟着你漂，一直保持高度。
lines.en: I drift after you, holding my height.

lines.zh: 你挪到哪，我的手指就指到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you shift, my finger follows.
I sink a little lower.
You are backing toward the island's edge.

lines.zh: 我从你视线的死角切入。
lines.en: I cut in from your blind side.
Your breath has lost its beat.

lines.zh: 我掌心那团光越来越亮。
lines.en: The light in my palm grows brighter.
I have your landing spot figured.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，可我射的是上方。
lines.en: You raise a guard; my shot comes from above.
Two more steps and there is no ground.

lines.zh: 我不急，末地很大，你走不远。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the end is large but you will not go far.
Your blood is starting to burn.
I fold my wings and circle half around you.
This stretch of void is all mine.
Time is up.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，带着血光。
lines.en: My palm comes down with blood light.

lines.zh: 我伸手一抓，骨指扣住它。
lines.en: I reach and bone fingers close on it.
I throw out a blade of light.
That blow passes through its armor.
My wing sweeps and throws it off.

lines.zh: 它砍中我的肋骨，我照样抬手。
lines.en: It cuts my ribs and I still raise my hand.
I strike again without pause.
Blood light strikes with a dull sound.
I draw my hand back to my chest.
It retreats and I hang where I am.
My bones crack and set back in place.
I raise my palm once more.
That one leaves it unsteady.

lines.zh: 我飘高了些，从上面看它。
lines.en: I drift higher to watch it from above.

lines.zh: 我从虚空里浮出来，翅膀先出现。
lines.en: I surface from the void, wings first.

lines.zh: 末地的风把我的骨色吹亮。
lines.en: The end wind brightens my bone.

lines.zh: 我一出现，附近的末影人都退了。
lines.en: The moment I appear, the endermen withdraw.

lines.zh: 我悬在浮岛上方，慢慢转。
lines.en: I hang over the island and turn slowly.
Blood light shines through my chest.
I sweep a glance over the wasteland.

lines.zh: 脚下的末地石被我的光映红。
lines.en: End stone below me turns red in my light.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开，遮住一片。
lines.en: My wings open and block a patch.
The void lies open and still below.
I settle and my bones crack.
This is ground I know.
I raise a hand and light draws into a line.
A floating island lies far off; I note it.
Fire reaches me and my bones blacken.

lines.zh: 我撞在末地石上，骨架散了半边。
lines.en: I hit end stone and half my frame scatters.
Water closes in and I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀开，骨片四散。
lines.en: The blast throws me and bone fragments fly.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我的胸腔，留下一个洞。
lines.en: Something passes through my chest and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 术式压住我的血光，我暗了下来。
lines.en: An art pins my blood light and I dim.

lines.zh: 我太久没收到血，光在淡。
lines.en: Too long without blood and my light fades.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我全身，我被劈得停住。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me and freezes me midair.

lines.zh: 虚空吞下我，我散成了光。
lines.en: The void takes me and I scatter into light.
